tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Sage green, the brand color: primary buttons, active states, focus border on inputs, icons. White text on it is 3.6:1 (source value kept; use for large or bold labels).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Muted terracotta for human highlights and warmth touches. Decorative or large only: 2.9:1 on background.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Dusty rose for empathetic, subtle UI accents. Decorative only.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Warm taupe: secondary button fill (carries foreground text, 7.4:1) and supporting UI depth.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App background, warm off-white. Text on it: foreground, subtitle.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, surface, sheet (12.1:1 and up in light; 16.3:1 as #f7f3ee on dark background).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers (1.6:1: decorative separators, not the only cue for a control).

tokens.name: subtitle
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, labels on background and surface (4.9:1 and 5.4:1 in light). In dark it is unchanged and drops below 4.5:1: prefer foreground there.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text only (2.3:1 on surface: source value kept; never carry essential information).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted, tertiary text and marks.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled state fills and borders; app also lowers opacity to 0.4.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and toast backdrop.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet and modal background.

tokens.name: underlay
tokens.usage: Pressable underlay.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surface on top of surface (web).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border (web).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Genuine alerts and destructive actions only; white on it is 3.8:1 (source value kept). Always pair with words or an icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Acknowledged and completed states. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending states. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of a primary-colored control (sage, darkened).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and outlined buttons (same value as neutral-300).

tokens.name: tint-sage
tokens.usage: Pastel card background from the sage. Text `foreground`.

tokens.name: tint-terracotta
tokens.usage: Pastel card background from the terracotta. Text `foreground`.

tokens.name: tint-rose
tokens.usage: Pastel card background from the dusty rose. Text `foreground`.

tokens.name: tint-taupe
tokens.usage: Pastel card background from the taupe. Text `foreground`.

tokens.name: tint-sage-bold
tokens.usage: The one high-emphasis banner on a page. Text `foreground`.

tokens.name: home-a
tokens.usage: Calendar fill for the first home (sage). Decorative: always labelled.

tokens.name: home-b
tokens.usage: Calendar fill for the second home (rose). Decorative: always labelled.

tokens.name: kbd-button
tokens.usage: Keyboard accessory button.

tokens.name: kbd-surface
tokens.usage: Keyboard accessory background.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and error fills.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Rarely used; prefer foreground.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Lightest warm neutral.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Same value as background.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Icon circle backgrounds and muted containers.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Subtle borders and input borders (default input border).

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Same value as divider and secondary.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Mid-tone icons and text (3.4:1 on background: large text only).

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Same value as subtitle.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Dark text and headings.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Dark-mode surfaces and borders.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Dark-mode backgrounds and surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Darkest neutral.

styles.name: hero-display
styles.usage: Landing hero headline (80 → 56 → 48 → 36px as the screen narrows).

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles and app page titles.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Feature tile titles and section headers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, active sidebar items and navigation.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Compact vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Small gaps (the primary increment).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding and list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row padding in tables and lists.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Feature card padding and page gutters.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Small section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section rhythm and CTA banner padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Hero band padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tag chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Type badges and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and search fields. Buttons are rectangles, never pills.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Every card family, panels and the product mockup.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Larger feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Large feature cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges, pill tabs and avatars only (not buttons).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Level 1: hover-raised tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Level 2: feature cards that need lift.

tokens.name: shadow-mockup
tokens.usage: Level 3: the product mockup on the hero band.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Level 4: modals and dropdowns.

tokens.name: button-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small button min height.

tokens.name: button-height-md
tokens.usage: Default button min height (10px × 18px padding).

tokens.name: button-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large button and touch-target min height.

tokens.name: input-height-md
tokens.usage: Default input and search field height.
